proposal.title: Bounded evidence prerequisites — make a proposal's declared metric threshold executable

manifest.method: Three surfaces, summed as integers with no exclusions after mint. (1) Every declared prerequisite that is not a string on a LEGACY row — a row created at or before the original's own frozen population generated_at. Rows authored after the bounded branch deployed are adoption of a deployed feature, not verdicts the deployment moved; counting them makes the metric grow with use and refutes the filing more strongly every time it is replicated. Both the snapshot boundary and the first-deploy boundary are computed and must agree ON THE COUNT or the run refuses. (2) Every authored acceptance case whose observed acceptance differs from its expected acceptance, against the public non-mutating preflight screen; a rate-limited or 5xx probe aborts rather than scoring, because an unanswered case is not evidence about the rule. (3) One surface if the deployed OpenAPI object union is not confined to prerequisites. File every finite count, including a non-zero one.
